name: senpi-agent
description: Turn your AI assistant into your AI quant engineer for perpetual futures markets. Ask your own Senpi agent what's moving, run a signals sweep, read smart-money positioning, research traders, score any wallet with the Quant Desk, review your own portfolio and trades, and work through a strategy. Research and analysis first; trades and changes need your approval, in the conversation or in your Senpi app settings, and deposits and withdrawals stay in the Senpi app.
